# User auth

## Purpose
Identity of users. Builds on spec:auth/sign-in#valid-password.

## Requirements

### Requirement: User Record
The system SHALL keep one record per user.

#### Scenario: New user
- **WHEN** a user signs up
- **THEN** a record is created
